english:
Taking Combatant damage that breaks your Shield while <stasis Frost Armor /> is active releases a Stasis Burst in a 10 meter radius.

The Stasis Burst <stasis/>Freezes enemies and grants a stack of <stasis Frost Armor /> to you and allies in range.

source.text:
On Shield Break from Combatant Damage, while Frost Armor is active:

Releases a Stasis Burst over 10 meters.
Stasis Burst freezes enemies and grants a stack of Frost Armor to the user and allies in range.
